Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, ExtractionConfig, OcrElementLevel, extract } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, mimeType: "image/png", uri: "https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png" };
  const config: ExtractionConfig = { forceOcr: true, ocr: { backend: "tesseract", elementConfig: { includeElements: true, minLevel: OcrElementLevel.Word }, enabled: true, language: ["eng"] } };
  const result = await extract(input, config);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.ocrElements);
}

void main();
```
